races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares Beginners Chase
races.narrative:
## RACE SHAPE
With only 6 runners in a slowly-run beginners chase, expect a tactical affair with limited early pace. Traffic and positioning will be crucial at the business end, particularly given the soft ground conditions that will test stamina reserves.

## MOST LIKELY WINNER
Neon Diamond tops the model despite being 6lbs below field average OR, suggesting the ratings underestimate her ability. The 18.7% edge indicates significant market inefficiency, likely due to her lower official rating masking genuine ability in this weak field.

## KEY DANGERS
Gaoth Chuil brings the highest OR at 122 and solid 20% win probability, needing to translate hurdles form to fences. Kilbarry Saint (OR 125) has the class edge but must handle the step up in trip and soft conditions effectively.

## VALUE VERDICT
Neon Diamond offers the standout value proposition with model odds of 5/2 against what should be longer market prices given her modest rating.

Low confidence rating suggests limited public form to assess.

races.name: Glenary Handicap Hurdle (Div I)
races.narrative:

With 17 runners on soft ground, traffic problems are inevitable in the straight, making an prominent position crucial. Early leaders will likely weaken, setting up a sprint finish from the back of the field.

## MOST LIKELY WINNER
Uncle Gerhard tops the model at 5/1 with a significant 37.2% edge, suggesting the handicapper has been lenient with his OR 85 mark. His medium confidence rating indicates solid recent form data supports this assessment, making him the standout selection in a competitive field.

## KEY DANGERS
Finnicky Filly (10/1 model) carries 22.3% edge despite her OR 83 rating, likely thriving in the expected strong pace scenario. Lissen To The Lady brings the highest class rating (OR 89) and similar 22.2% model edge, needing the soft ground to suit her stamina-laden profile. Lucky Crystal offers the biggest outsider threat at 13/1 with 22.1% edge from a low OR 81 base.

## VALUE VERDICT
Focus on Uncle Gerhard as the clear model leader, with Lucky Crystal representing excellent each-way value given his substantial edge at longer odds.
